headline: NVIDIA reports Kubernetes validation on two early Vera Rubin NVL72 clusters
summary: NVIDIA describes bringing an NVIDIA AI Cluster Runtime (AICR) Preview recipe online on two early Vera Rubin NVL72 reference clusters. Its public account says the training recipe passed deployment and conformance checks and a cross-node 16 GiB NCCL all-reduce gate at 744.71 GB/s bus bandwidth. The inference variant passed deployment and conformance only; NVIDIA explicitly says inference-serving performance remains deferred. These are company-reported results for a Preview configuration, not independent reproduction or production qualification.
